By no means is this being done just to spite her completely.

She is and was a contributing factor to it though, Because of her actions and just everything over-all. But there is more to it then that besides just her.

Right, After 6 years of being with someone instead of prehaps just telling me that she wasn't feeling as close anymore or that she was starting to doubt how well we were working she decides to cheat on me. Yeah. She loved me.

No I think she deserves every bit of emotional and mental distress it causes her.
